requirements.normalized_clause: **DEFAULT deadlines:** begin inspection immediately after a fill; if protection is unconfirmed after 2 seconds, cancel any remaining entry, attempt stop repair and issue a reduce-only flatten through Nautilus. If connectivity prevents action, remain RECOVERY_REQUIRED and alert; never claim an exit happened.

requirements.normalized_clause: **Exit:** cancel outstanding opening orders, retaining native protection. Submit the opposite side with an explicit quantity no greater than the freshest reconciled position and **reduce_only=true**. Do not use a generic “close all” parameter or zero quantity. The first time exit uses an IOC limit with the configured exit collar; if still open, refresh quantity and retry under the bounded exit policy. After two seconds unresolved, request an explicit-quantity reduce-only market exit; partial/no execution remains possible. All attempts are persisted and observed, never assumed successful.
